truth_policy: Build profiles are not interchangeable. Asset concepts and generic image-processing logic may be shared, but assembly hashes, data-folder layouts, scene/object IDs, PathIDs, runtime bridges and proof evidence are build-specific unless independently re-verified.

creator-0.11.272.role: Barro's Pizza Creator RC1 certified reverse-engineering/runtime target
creator-0.11.272.studio_asset_tools: allowed only after this build is separately scanned/indexed

studio-1.11.403.role: Runtime Proof Studio primary PC3 extraction/conversion target

assembly_csharp.truth_state: must be discovered/retained from the operator's verified build before assembly-specific reuse

studio-1.11.403.pizza_creator_runtime: not certified by the Creator 0.11.272 assembly evidence; do not install the RC1 Creator plugin unless separately ported and proven

routing_rules: Creator proof/build/install must use creator-0.11.272 and the exact two assembly SHA-256 values.
Studio 1.11.403 PathIDs, scene mappings and runtime bridge evidence must not be copied to creator-0.11.272 without re-extraction/re-verification.
A PNG/JPEG handoff should record target.build_profile whenever the intended binary build is known.
If target.build_profile is absent, Studio may validate the image file contract but must treat runtime mapping as NOT_RUN until a build-specific target is selected.
User-facing branding may be shared across profiles; technical filenames/IDs remain build-native.
